facts.content: Patient has had a fever for 7 days with alternating hot and cold sensations, night sweats, diffuse muscle pain, nausea, decreased oral intake, and fatigue.
facts.source_text: CC: 7d fever with alternating hot/cold; night sweats; diffuse myalgias; nausea; ↓ PO intake; fatigue

facts.content: Over-the-counter paracetamol and ibuprofen at recommended doses provide partial relief.
facts.source_text: OTC: Paracetamol + ibuprofen at recommended doses → partial relief

facts.content: Patient returned from Vietnam 4 weeks ago with urban and rural exposure including trekking and cycling through farmland, and was on daily malaria prophylaxis.
facts.source_text: Travel/Exposure: Returned from Vietnam 4w ago; urban + rural exposure incl trekking/cycling through farmland; took daily malaria ppx—agent(s) unknown

facts.content: Patient has no cough, coryza, sore throat, ear pain, diarrhea, neck stiffness, rash, joint swelling or tenderness, or lower urinary tract symptoms.
facts.source_text: ROS: No cough/coryza/sore throat; no ear pain; no diarrhea; no neck stiffness; HAs baseline only (screen/weather-related); no rash; no joint swelling/tenderness; no LUTS (dysuria/frequency)

facts.content: Patient experiences headaches which are baseline and related to screen and weather.
facts.source_text: HAs baseline only (screen/weather-related)

facts.content: Patient has chronic back pain associated with a sedentary posture and is in physiotherapy.
facts.source_text: PMH: Chronic back pain (sedentary posture); in physiotherapy

facts.content: Patient is taking Seroxat (paroxetine), paracetamol, and ibuprofen.
facts.source_text: Meds: Seroxat (paroxetine); paracetamol; ibuprofen

facts.content: Patient has an allergy to pollen causing hay fever.
facts.source_text: Allergies: Pollen (hay fever)

facts.content: Patient's father had a myocardial infarction at age 68.
facts.source_text: FH: Father MI at 68

facts.content: Patient is a nurse and up to date with vaccinations including Hepatitis B.
facts.source_text: SH: Nurse; vax UTD incl Hep B

facts.content: Patient is a non-smoker, consumes alcohol moderately, exercises a few times per week, and is struggling at work due to fatigue.
facts.source_text: non-smoker; mod etOH; exercises a few times/wk; struggling at work due to fatigue

facts.content: Acute febrile illness for 7 days without localizing symptoms and recent rural exposure in Vietnam. Differential diagnosis includes malaria, other travel-related infections, and viral illness.
facts.source_text: 1) Acute febrile illness x7d without localizing sxs; post-travel (Vietnam 4w ago) with rural exposure. ddx incl malaria vs other travel-related infection vs viral illness.

facts.content: The patient has a risk of dehydration due to poor intake and fever.
facts.source_text: 2) Risk of dehydration given poor intake and fever.

facts.content: Chronic back pain remains stable with physiotherapy.
facts.source_text: 3) Chronic back pain—stable on physio.

facts.content: Patient is scheduled for an urgent in-person exam today at a central London clinic or local A&E if the clinic is inconvenient.
facts.source_text: Urgent in-person exam today at central London clinic; if inconvenient, attend local A&E

facts.content: Plan includes doing labs like thick/thin blood films for malaria and inflammatory markers, with further tests as per examiner’s discretion.
facts.source_text: Labs: Thick/thin blood films for malaria; inflammatory markers; further tests per examiner; urgency per exam findings

facts.content: Patient's travel history and malaria prophylaxis to be documented in referral.
facts.source_text: Document travel hx and malaria ppx in referral

facts.content: clinician to enter plan and tests in the consult note for reception.
facts.source_text: Clinician to enter plan/tests in consult note for reception

facts.content: Patient advised to remain off work until evaluated and cleared.
facts.source_text: Off work until evaluated/cleared

facts.content: The administration team to book clinic slot, and the patient to call the provided number for scheduling today.
facts.source_text: Admin: Team to book clinic slot; pt to call number provided in consult notes to be scheduled today
